name: gds-estate-admin
description: Control-plane-only GDS estate audit, planning, lifecycle, recovery, maintenance, release, and rollout workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Administer the GDS estate through explicit plans
interface.longDescription: Provides control-plane and portfolio GDS workflows. Mutating workflows are explicit-only and remain subject to deterministic plan, approval, apply, verify, and journal gates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit or plan the requested estate change without applying it unless explicitly approved.
